notes: Ferrari et al. 2006, PRL 97, 187401 (arXiv cond-mat/0606284, p.2, 514 nm): G about 1580 and 2D about 2700 cm-1; the graphene G line sits 3 to 5 cm-1 above that of bulk graphite.
The 2D band is second order and disperses with laser energy; positions apply to 514.5 nm.
Strain shifts at 514 nm (Mohiuddin et al. 2009, PRB 79, 205433, arXiv 0812.1538): G+ -10.8, G- -31.7, 2D -64 cm-1/% uniaxial.
omitted: D band (defect-activated, near 1350 cm-1 at visible excitation) and D' band: no position read from a source yet, so left out of the matcher table.
